headline: Session done — easy spin delivered as a cautious swap, no strides logged
summary: Prescribed was 28min Z1-Z2 run (138-150bpm) + 4x20s strides on flat/treadmill, but what's logged is 40min of Indoor Cycling at avg HR 137 (load 36 vs 30 planned), feel 2/Good, RPE 2. No strides, no run — this was swapped to the bike, likely a conservative read of yesterday's amber trend (HRV dropped from 78 to 55 on Nov 1, still soft at 56-67 the last two days) plus general fatigue management 4 days from the race. HR band was right in the Z1-Z2 target throughout, so as a leg-turnover/recovery session it did its job even though it wasn't the prescribed modality. ATL has dropped nicely from 77 (Oct 31) to 65.2 today while CTL holds at 56.6, basically on the Wk8 start-line target — freshness is building as intended. Tomorrow's shakeout and Friday's opener in Tirano are the last chances to get actual running strides in before Saturday's race, so that's worth flagging rather than letting two more easy days slip to the bike.
flags: No run strides done in 2 days now (swapped Oct-31 Z2 long run completed fine, but today's run-specific leg-speed work was skipped) — want legs feeling race-ready pace by Tirano.

HRV 67 / RHR 48 today is back to healthy range after yesterday's amber dip, so the bike swap wasn't strictly forced by readiness — worth checking if it was a deliberate taper choice or just logistics.
suggestedChange: Confirm with Alberto whether Wed (tomorrow, 35min) should include the strides that were skipped today, to get at least one dose of race-pace leg turnover in before Saturday.
